title: fix(cli): os i18n check reads inlineHelpText as the default-locale source of a field help key
body:
Fixes #25683

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The inline source of a field's help key (`objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.help`) in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` is now `field.help ?? field.inlineHelpText ?? field.description`, per the triage route: `inlineHelpText` is the default-locale source, after `help` and before `description`, the same way an authored label is (#15711, ruled A). A field that authors `inlineHelpText` and translates `help` into one locale no longer has its default locale reported as missing; a non-default locale with no `help` is still reported.

## Mechanism measured

That call is the only site where the field help key takes default-locale text (`git grep` for `help ??` in `packages/**/src` finds only it). Other help-key sites, each with a verdict:

- Flow screen fields (`flows.FLOW.screens.NODE.fields.FIELD.inlineHelpText`): already read `inlineHelpText` directly, no fallback chain. No change.
- Form section entries (`_sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD.helpText`): read the entry's own `helpText` only, no `help ?? description`. No change.
- Bulk action params (`params.PARAM.help`) and action params (`params.PARAM.helpText`): read their own single key. No change.
- `metadataForms.TYPE.fields.PATH.helpText`: own single key. No change.

## Landing differs from the claim's file surface (one file added)

The claim named the extractor, its tests and one changeset. The change makes the showcase example's `contact.lead_score` field (it authors `inlineHelpText`) owe a zh-CN help, so `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` went red (320 to 321 untranslated declared strings). Fixed by translating it in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` (one zh-CN `help` string), not by raising the baseline. Gate green again at 320.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-inline-help-text.test.ts` (6 cases): inlineHelpText emitted as the inline text; source order help, inlineHelpText, description; inlineHelpText-only field plus an `en` bundle with `help` leaves the default locale unreported; a non-default locale missing `help` is still reported; description-only case unchanged; no-inline-source case unchanged.

- Fix commit fc0e06c2: 6/6 pass.
- Ablation on the committed fix (anchor replaced back to `field.help ?? field.description` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob changed): 3 of 6 fail (the inline emission, source-order and default-locale cases), then restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `../src`, so no rebuild leg applies.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/i18n`: 31 files, 341 tests pass. `@objectstack/example-showcase` test: 39 files, 484 tests pass. `@objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.

## Gates (local subset, final head 8c1cdf8b)

All 72 derived families run and reconciled with `dispatch-gates --ran` (72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). Every one exits 0 on the final tree after prerequisite builds, except `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (needs a full `pnpm build`), NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it. Scoped eslint over the touched files: exit 0.

## Acceptance

hotsrm's case (inlineHelpText plus an `en` help, no zh-CN entry) passes the strict coverage check: pinned by the third test case. hotsrm can drop its temporary zh-CN bundle.
